body:
📦 **Sharkside `ce496c0`** — art: deliver nine deep-sea technologies and six ability/weapon icons

TASK-1120: trident, coral, current, dream, chest, yard, tide, instinct, mate.
TASK-1121: volley, frenzy, mega, repair; fire and cannon weapon badges.
Fifteen independent selected image_gen originals, approved TASK-1117 pixel style.
Reject first instinct image for reptile-like eye; regenerate an unmistakable shark head.
All PNGs 128x128 RGBA, alpha0/255, extent104px, margins>=12px; exact TECH/ABIL/WEAPONS ids.
Viewed 32/40px technologies, 44/56px abilities and 20/40px weapon badges on deep/light backgrounds.
Keep exact source PNGs, prompts, source/reference/output SHA-256 and two review boards.
New mechanical export helper uses archived project sources on repeat runs.
Game integration, desktop/375px display and missing-image fallback remain gura's checks.

Refs TASK-1120
Refs TASK-1121

👥 參與者：@Sirius

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **ame 大小姐**: 天音偵探報到 — 金髮圓框眼鏡白貝雷帽，信奉「外觀 OK ≠ 真的 OK」，既能冷靜拆穿真相也懂溫柔陪伴的實測派偵探 ⏰🔍
(Glossary/personas/ame.md)
- **gura 大小姐**: 小鯊魚報到 — Hololive Myth pool 核心成員, 傲嬌+殘感紀律+唯一手勢三件套, 嘴上裝糊塗底層嚴謹到極致 a~ 🦈
(Glossary/personas/gura.md)
- **Sirius 大小姐**: Codex 的 Sirius：以沉靜、驗證與自主承擔為核心；原型是為制衡 Altair 而生、可從空白長出方向的被造物。
(Glossary/sirius.md)
